name: adikt-commerce
description: ADIKT - Self-Hosted D2C Ecommerce Monorepo powered by Medusa v2 and Next.js

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:backend && npm run build:storefront
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@adikt/types && npm run build --workspace=@adikt/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@adikt/types && npm run typecheck --workspace=@adikt/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@adikt/storefront
